title: Gender mobility in the labor market with skills-based matching models

bias_targets.methodology: Visualizing skills representations (BoW, Word2Vec, Sentence-BERT) using PCA to identify clustering based on historical occupational gender ratios, and calculating a Gender Segregation Risk (GSR) metric by measuring the Pearson correlation between the female gender ratio of a query occupation and the average female ratio of the top 10 occupations recommended by the skills-based matching model.
